etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 屯 (phonetic ジュン) — raw silk before any dye: unmixed, pure.
mnemonic: Thread the exact color it was born — ジュン. 純粋: nothing added, nothing hidden.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 處): feet come to rest at the table (几) — where one settles: a place; settling matters: to handle, dispose.
mnemonic: Sit down and deal with it — ショ. 処理: the desk where things stop circulating.

etymology: Phono-semantic: net (罒) + 者 (phonetic ショ) — personnel assigned across the net of posts: a station, office; to sign one's post: signature.
mnemonic: The duty roster's grid with your name in a box — ショ. 警察署: the box with sirens; 署名: your box, inked.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 者 (phonetic ショ) — all the ones spoken of: various, the several.
mnemonic: '…and associated others' — ショ. 諸国, 諸問題: the et-cetera made official.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 余 (phonetic ジョ) — clearing the path up the mound: to remove, exclude; division in math.
mnemonic: Shovel the extra off the steps — のぞく. 掃除: the daily exclusion of dust.

etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic (爿) + hand presenting meat — the one who presides at the offering: commander; who leads what comes next: 'about to'.
mnemonic: The general serves the first portion — ショウ. 将来: where the column is headed; 将棋: war on a board.

etymology: Pictograph: hands raised to catch what is handed down — to receive from above: to accept, to hear (humbly).
mnemonic: Both hands up, catching the decision — うけたまわる. 承知しました: caught, and holding.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 烝 'rising vapor over fire' (phonetic ジョウ) — heat rising through: to steam.
mnemonic: Greens in the basket, fire below, cloud above — むす. 蒸し暑い: the weather doing it to you.

etymology: Compound: metal (金) + 十 — the original pictograph of the needle (十 was a needle before it was 'ten'): the metal needle, the hand of a clock.
mnemonic: 十 got its old job back, in steel — はり. 方針: the needle a policy follows.

etymology: Pictograph: a spindle turned by one hand (寸) — one axis, one motion: exclusive, specialized.
mnemonic: The wheel spins on exactly one thing — もっぱら. 専門: the spindle you chose for life.

etymology: Pictograph: water welling white from the rock — the spring, the source.
mnemonic: White water rising out of nowhere — いずみ. 温泉: the spring that runs hot.

etymology: Compound: the sacrificial sheep (羊) over words of blessing — goodness spoken and offered: virtuous.
mnemonic: The gentle animal and the kind sentence, stacked — ゼン. 改善: goodness with a to-do list.

etymology: Phono-semantic: structure (尸) + 曽 'layers' (phonetic ソウ) — floors stacked in a building, strata in rock or society.
mnemonic: Story on story, sediment with elevators — ソウ. 高層ビル: strata you can rent.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 喿 (phonetic ソウ) — the hand in full command: to operate, handle; a grip that never slips: integrity.
mnemonic: Fingers on every lever at once — あやつる. 体操: operating your own body like machinery.

etymology: Phono-semantic: opening (穴) + a phonetic — the wall's opening for light and air: window.
mnemonic: The hole the house breathes through, with your heart parked at it — まど. 窓side seats sell out first.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 壮 (phonetic ソウ) + garment (衣) — dressed for the part: attire; fitted out: to equip, feign.
mnemonic: The costume that makes the role — ソウ. 服装 for people, 装置 for machines: everyone dressed to function.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 蔵 'storehouse' (phonetic ゾウ) — the body's stored organs: viscera.
mnemonic: The torso's warehouse shelves — ゾウ. 心臓: the one machine in the warehouse that never clocks out.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cover (艹) + 臧 (phonetic ゾウ) — goods hidden away under guard: storehouse, to conceal.
mnemonic: The thick-walled kura behind the shop — くら. 冷蔵庫: the kura that hums.

etymology: Compound: the sprout (才) with the child (子) — young life persisting: to exist, remain; held in mind: to know (ご存じ).
mnemonic: The seedling and the child both keep going — ソン. 存在: the stubbornness of being here.

etymology: Compound ideograph: hands (寸) lifting the ceremonial wine vessel (酋) — raised high: honored, revered.
mnemonic: The vessel lifted above eye level — とうとい. 尊敬: holding a person the same way.

etymology: Compound: movement (辶) + 艮 'stopping' — walking back from the line: to withdraw, retire.
mnemonic: Steps taken in reverse, dignity intact — しりぞく. 退院: retreating from the hospital, gladly.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 乇 'taking root' (phonetic タク) — the roof one roots under: residence.
mnemonic: Where your roots reach the floorboards — タク. お宅: your rooted place; 宅配: parcels aimed at roots.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 擔): hand (扌) + 旦 (phonetic タン) — hoisted onto the shoulder: to bear, take charge of.
mnemonic: Lift it at dawn, set it down at dusk — かつぐ. 担当: the load with your name on the manifest.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 罙 'deep' (phonetic タン) — the hand feeling into the dark: to probe, search.
mnemonic: Arm in the hole up to the elbow, hoping — さがす. 探偵: groping through other people's dark.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 爰 (phonetic ダン) — the sun lending a hand: warm (of air and rooms).
mnemonic: Sunlight passed down like a rope — あたたかい. 暖房: the rope, plugged in.

etymology: Compound: notches hewn (殳) into the slope — steps cut in rock: stairs, grades, stages.
mnemonic: Chisel one step, then the next — ダン. 階段 climbs buildings; 段々 climbs anything, gradually.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 直 (phonetic チ) — what a thing squarely comes to: its value, price.
mnemonic: Looked at straight, it's worth exactly this — ね, あたい. 値段: honesty in digits.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 由 (phonetic チュウ) — the vault overhead: mid-air; with 宇, all of space.
mnemonic: The ceiling with no beams: hang anything there — チュウ. 宇宙: the roofless roof.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 者 (phonetic チョ) — set down visibly: to write, publish; visibly known: renowned.
mnemonic: The someone (者) whose name grew leaves — チョ. 著者: the name on the spine.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 廳): building (广) + 丁 (phonetic チョウ) — the hall where affairs are heard: agency, office.
mnemonic: The building with a number and no charm — チョウ. 県庁, 気象庁: bureaucracy's roofline.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 丁 (phonetic チョウ) + head (頁) — the crown of the head: summit; receiving raised to one's head: humbly accept (頂く).
mnemonic: Held above your head in thanks — いただく. 山頂: where the mountain does the same.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 任 'burden' (phonetic チン) + money (貝) — payment for the burden borne: wages, fare, rent.
mnemonic: The load priced per shoulder-mile — チン. 家賃, 運賃: what carrying costs.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 甬 (phonetic ツウ) — the ache running through like a pipe: pain.
mnemonic: The hurt with its own plumbing — いたい. 頭痛, 腹痛: pain, routed by district.

etymology: Compound: cloth spread wide under a roof (尸) — rolled things opened out: to unfold, display, develop.
mnemonic: The bolt of silk rolled across the whole floor — テン. 展覧会: unfolding, ticketed.

etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 黨): 尚 (phonetic トウ) + a base — those gathered under one banner: a faction, a political party.
mnemonic: Matching armbands, matching slogans, one roof — トウ. 政党: the faction with microphones.

etymology: Compound: brought all the way in under the roof (尸) — to arrive at its destination: to deliver, to reach; the notification filed: 届け.
mnemonic: Not delivered until it's through the door — とどく. 荷物が届いた: the kanji's happy ending.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 堇 (phonetic ナン) + bird (隹) — the bird mired in clay: hardship, difficulty.
mnemonic: Wings caked in mud, still flapping — むずかしい. 難しい: every learner's most-written kanji review.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand guiding a child (子) to the breast (乚) — nursing: milk.
mnemonic: The oldest meal service in the mammal business — ちち. 牛乳: the cow's edition.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 忍 'bear patiently' (phonetic ニン) — examining until one accepts: to recognize, acknowledge.
mnemonic: Look long enough to say 'yes, it's so' — みとめる. 確認: saying it twice to be safe.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + a skull-and-hair phonetic — the organ in the skull: brain.
mnemonic: The body's control room, drawn with its antenna hair — ノウ. 頭脳: hardware; 脳みそ: the affectionate name.

etymology: Compound: hands pressed together with the offering branch — the bow of reverence: to worship; humble prefix in letters (拝啓).
mnemonic: Palms together, forehead down — おがむ. 拝む: the shrine's opening gesture.

etymology: Compound: 北 'backs turned' + flesh (月) — the body's back: the back; how tall it stands: stature; turning one's back: to betray.
mnemonic: The side you can't see of yourself — せ. 背が高い: measured up the back.

etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 免 'escape' (phonetic バン) — the sun slipping away: evening, night.
mnemonic: The sun makes its escape and dinner begins — バン. 今晩, 晩ご飯: the escape, celebrated nightly.

etymology: Compound ideograph: 不 'not' given a mouth (口) — the no spoken aloud: to negate, deny.
mnemonic: 不 finally says it out loud — いな. 否定: no, with grammar; 安否: the yes-or-no of safety.
